server_host.description: IP address the server listens on. Use 0.0.0.0 to listen on all interfaces.

server_port.description: TCP port the server listens on.

server_maxplayers.description: Maximum number of players allowed in a single game.

server_maxgames.description: Maximum number of games the server will run simultaneously.

server_nickname.description: Public nickname displayed in server lists.

server_admin.description: Admin password for server administration commands.

server_logfile.description: Path to the server log file.

ruleset_default.description: Default ruleset name (e.g., civ2, civ1, classic).

ruleset_path.description: Path to the default ruleset directory.

networking_maxping.description: Maximum allowed ping in ms before disconnect (0 = disabled).

networking_maxidle.description: Seconds of idle time before auto-disconnect (0 = disabled).

networking_allownewgames.description: Whether clients may create new games (true/false).

saving_savegamesdir.description: Directory where saved games are stored.

saving_savereplays.description: Whether to save game replays for later review.

ai_count.description: Number of AI players to add to new games by default.

ai_names.description: List of AI player names to use in new games.

hosts.description: Access control rules: list of host patterns and access levels. Use 'all' for universal access.

access.description: Access level: 'full' (connect and play), 'read' (spectate only), or 'none' (block)
